title: بيريز يفي بوعده الانتخابي لأعضاء ريال مدريد
summary: بدأ ريال مدريد، التواصل مع أعضائه، لتسليمهم القميص التذكاري الحصري الذي وعد فلورنتينو بيريز بتقديمه، خلال حملته الانتخابية، حال إعادة انتخابه.

title: اعترافات ما بعد فوات الأوان.. رئيس الزمالك يجلد مجلسه ويكشف فاتورة الـ7 ملايين دولار
summary: فجّر حسين لبيب، رئيس نادي الزمالك، عدة مفاجآت بشأن كواليس فترة إدارته للنادي، معترفًا بوجود أخطاء في تشكيل مجلس الإدارة، ومقرًا بأن المجلس يتحمل مسؤولية ديون جديدة تقترب من 7 ملايين دولار، رغم سداد جزء كبير من الالتزامات المالية التي ورثها عند توليه المسؤولية.

title: CD Projekt used AI to modify the voice of Geralt's Polish actor after a stroke left it significantly changed: 'This was a special case'
summary: Jacek Rozenek was the voice of Geralt in all previous Polish-language Witcher releases, and CD Projekt wanted to work with him again—but his voice is no longer a match.
body: Game File reports that CD Projekt worked with AI company Respeecher to modify the voice of Geralt's Polish voice actor in the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt . The actor, Jacek Rozenek , voiced Geralt in the Polish editions of all the Witcher games, including The Witcher 3 and its two expansions, and the Game File report says his performances are highly regarded. But in 2019, he had a stroke that left him temporarily unable to speak; by 2021 he had rehabilitated enough to be able to provide some new lines for The Witcher 3's next-gen update , but the process left him "exhausted." Still, he continued to train and was eventually able to return to work, and when CD Projekt decided to make a new Witcher 3 expansion it wanted him back for the role. But the stroke, and the passage of time, had left Rozenek's voice noticeably changed. Given that Songs of the Past will occur in the midst of The Witcher 3, that shift in tone—"lower [and] gruffer," according to Game File's Stephen Totilo—presented a problem.
